newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso ends down vs dlr but off record low.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso ends down vs dlr but off record low.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 3.70 pesos lower against the dollar at 1,088.80, after touching bottom at a historic intraday low of 1,089.00, interbank dealers said.

They said dollar-buying by an unspecified government office or agency, totalling about $20 million, knocked support out from under the peso despite rumors of a large and imminent sale of U.S. currency stemming from oil export revenues.

The peso hit a session high of 1,084.80 before moving sharply lower into the close, dealers said, adding that the market processed an above-average 403 trades for a total of $197 million. ((-- Nelson Bocanegra, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944))
